mapper.select: select count(*) from CHB_TRANSFORM_RULE where TARGET_FIELD=#{targetField} and STATUS='E'

select SEQNO seqno, TRANS_TYPE transType, ORG_FIELD orgField, PINGYING pinyin, FIELD_UNICODE fieldUnicode, TARGET_FIELD targetField, STATUS dataStatus, IS_MODIFY isModify, REMARK remark, UPDATE_USER updateUser, CREATE_USER createUser, CREATE_DEPT createDept from CHB_TRANSFORM_RULE where SEQNO=#{seqno}
mapper.insert: insert into CHB_TRANSFORM_RULE(SEQNO,TRANS_TYPE,ORG_FIELD,PINGYING,FIELD_UNICODE, TARGET_FIELD,STATUS,IS_MODIFY,REMARK,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_USER,CREATE_TIME,CREATE_DEPT) values (f_guid(), #{transType,jdbcType=CHAR} , #{orgField,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{pinyin,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{fieldUnicode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{targetField,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{dataStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{isModify,jdbcType=CHAR} , #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
